messages:
sylvie: Quick follow-up from the overnight postmortem — span-loss + bad aggregation incident. We need to close out remediation items and set a recurring cadence to catch regressions. Linking postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-5842 :eyes:
akhil: I can take the ETL backfill + row-level correctness check. Plan: run targeted backfill for missing day ranges and validate counts. ETA: Wed EOD.
matts: I'll own aggregation test coverage — add end-to-end tests that exercise the new grouping logic and edge cases for null spans. Will add a CI nightly smoke job.
olivia: I'll take monitoring/alerts and the runbook edits. Proposal: add a weekly 'span-coverage' job + alert if processed_span_count drops >20% vs hourly baseline.
sylvie: @akhil @matts @olivia assign tickets in obs-remediations board, tag with "postmortem:INC-5842" and set due dates. Also decide owners for long-term fixes vs quick remediations.
akhil: SQL I'll run for backfill (targeted):
```sql
-- copy missing spans from raw_events to spans_agg for 2026-03-18
INSERT INTO spans_agg (trace_id, span_id, start_ts, end_ts, payload)
SELECT trace_id, span_id, start_ts, end_ts, payload
FROM raw_events
WHERE event_type = 'span' AND start_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-18' AND '2026-03-19'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM spans_agg s WHERE s.trace_id = raw_events.trace_id AND s.span_id = raw_events.span_id);
```
I'll post estimated row counts by EOD.
matts: For CI smoke: I'll add a nightly job that runs synthetic traces through the pipeline and asserts 99.9% of spans preserved. If CI finds regressions, it opens a ticket to eng-runtime with stack traces.
olivia: Runbook note: update playbook with steps to toggle prefix/KV cache and how to force immediate reprocessing. Add remediation owner rotation (2 weeks) so one oncall maintains observability remediations.
triage-bot: Reminder: create ticket OBS-1219 for "span-coverage weekly job" assigned to olivia (due 2026-03-25).
sylvie: Good. One more thing — this pattern popped up 3x in last 6 months. We need a recurring root-cause trend review. Suggest monthly 30-min "obs regressions" sync to triage recurring patterns and decide structural fixes. Who can commit to monthly?
akhil: I'll attend monthly review. I'll bring sample deltas and backfill cost estimates.
matts: In. I'll bring CI failure stats and test coverage gaps.
olivia: I'll host the first session and book calendar. Agenda: (1) incident recurrence patterns, (2) test + alert gaps, (3) ownership cadence.
sylvie: Thanks. Can everyone drop short bullets into the board ticket by EOD Tuesday so I can compile and send to product/infra leads? :thumbsup:
akhil: Will do — adding estimated SLO hit and token-cost for backfill.
matts: Adding the test plan and PRs to watch.
olivia: Adding alert thresholds and runbook diffs.
sylvie: Great. After we have owners + tickets, I'll schedule weekly check-ins for the next 3 weeks to ensure progress. If anyone hits blockers ping me or @eng-oncall.
akhil: FYI — discovered one problematic partition that explains the lagged ETL; will include remediation steps in ticket.
matts: If we need extra compute for backfill, we should request dedicated burst capacity. I'll sync with infra.
olivia: Noted. Adding cost/ops impact to ticket.
sylvie: Ok closing this thread for now — will reopen after Tuesday updates. Thanks all. :rocket:
